ceiling_statement: For any system satisfying H1-H8, the maximum attainable grounding of a served legal text t is: (i) ORIGIN AUTHENTICITY no stronger than what can be TRANSPORTED or CORROBORATED — either verification of the official publisher's cryptographic signature over the captured bytes (transport), or agreement of a k-of-n quorum of independent, contemporaneous capture witnesses over the byte digest (corroboration), with anything below that admissible only as typed UNKNOWN/provisional; plus (ii) DERIVATION BINDING — a deterministic, third-party re-executable extraction function E with byte-equality E(captured-bytes) = t, committed as a dual digest (source-digest, extraction-digest); plus (iii) CORPUS-SIZE INDEPENDENCE — the truth of Grounded(t) mentions only the committed capture record of t's own source (selection by exact committed identifier, never by search/glob/statistics), so it is invariant under corpus extension, with verification cost O(log n) via Merkle inclusion. No feasible system exceeds this triple.
derivation: Part (i) is information-theoretic: authenticity of bytes fetched from a network endpoint cannot be created after the fact by any local computation — a digest commits to WHAT was received, never to WHO published it. The only two mechanisms that add origin assurance are (a) verifying a signature whose key predates the capture and roots in the publisher (authenticity is transported through the signature, bounded by the publisher's PKI), and (b) independent corroboration: if k witnesses on disjoint trust/network paths commit the same digest at capture time, forging the origin requires compromising all k or the publisher endpoint itself — a Byzantine-agreement-style bound that no single-observer scheme can match and no scheme can exceed without (a). H1 forbids substituting a statistical model's judgment of authenticity; H8 forbids trusting the producer's declared root, so recompute-over-committed-bytes is forced. Part (ii) is a verification-theory limit: 'served text derives from primary bytes' is checkable by a zero-trust third party ONLY if the derivation is a pure deterministic function (H5) whose re-execution can be compared byte-for-byte — any nondeterministic or judgment-bearing extraction step is unverifiable in principle offline, so the ceiling is exactly deterministic-replay equality. Part (iii): any grounding predicate that consults corpus-global state (search ranking, glob resolution, frequency) makes admissibility of one text depend on unrelated texts, which both breaks replay under corpus growth (H5/H7) and adds zero authenticity (corpus statistics carry no information about the gazette's bytes); commitment-based membership needs Θ(log n) with Merkle trees, and O(log n) suffices for feasibility, so per-item cost independent of semantic corpus content is attainable and nothing structurally better exists without trusted state.
attainment_mechanism: The dual-digest seat already exists and is supreme-grade: systems/orchestrator-epistemic/primary-anchor.lisp commits SOURCE-DIGEST (SHA-256 of the gazette's own bytes) and EXTRACTION-DIGEST (SHA-256 of the deterministically extracted served texts) on an immutable-class (sb-mop, write-once slots), and source/authority-evidence-replay.lisp re-runs source→spans→extraction→normalization→graph-text to byte equivalence with a typed awarded-tier lattice (tier>= comparisons, 'provisional-unanchored' floor — honest H2 behavior already in place). To attain the ceiling with today's stack: (1) extend authority-v2/capture/capture.py and source/government-source.lisp so every origin fetch is a capture record whose raw bytes are hashed into the source/merkle-authority.lisp RFC-9162 tree before any parsing; (2) verify the National Printing House PAdES/CMS signature embedded in ΦΕΚ PDFs using the existing strict-DER seat source/asn1-der.lisp plus the crypto already linked for Ed25519/RS256 verification (source/authority-proof-bundle.lisp, systems/orchestrator-epistemic/temporal-proof.lisp) — pure SBCL + standard cryptography, no new trust; (3) where the publisher artifact is unsigned, run k independent captures (distinct uids per authority-v2/capability/identities.sh, distinct network vantages or archive endpoints) and admit only on digest quorum, realizing the wire format already specified in authority-v2/log/witness-policy.sexp; anything below quorum stays at the existing provisional tier (fail-closed, H3); (4) delete the glob fallback in systems/orchestrator-core/source-detection.lisp so selection is only by exact committed FEK/ELI identifier; (5) generalize primary-anchor to an ordered multi-span excerpt with a committed gap-manifest (each omitted range justified and hashed), keeping extraction a total pure function.
b0_gap: Three gaps separate B0 from this ceiling, all named in the B0 map AX-04 row: (a) origin ingestion is un-attested — source/government-source.lisp fetches network bytes with heuristic HTML/PDF/CP1253 parsing and no signature verification, so the otherwise proof-carrying chain bottoms out on trust in fetched bytes; (b) the independent-witness tier is structurally NIL today — authority-evidence-replay.lisp's witness tier and authority-v2/log/witness-policy.sexp (external_quorum_status=disabled, split_view_resistance_claim nil) honestly declare no real witnesses exist, only the spec; (c) primary-anchor.lisp binds a single contiguous span only (no multi-span gap-manifest), and the glob fallback in systems/orchestrator-core/source-detection.lisp is still reachable, breaking strict corpus-size-independent selection.
lean_obligation: Model captures, witnesses, and extraction abstractly: given `hash : Bytes → Digest` (collision-resistant, axiom), `E : Bytes → ServedText` a total computable function, `sigOK : PublisherKey → Bytes → Sig → Prop`, and a finite witness set W each committing a digest at capture time. Define `Grounded (t : ServedText) (c : Capture) : Prop := (∃ s, sigOK pk c.bytes s ∨ ∃ (Q : Finset Witness), Q.card ≥ k ∧ ∀ w ∈ Q, w.commit = hash c.bytes) ∧ E c.bytes = t`. Prove: (T-ceiling) any grounding predicate P satisfying H5 (decidable by pure offline recomputation over committed data) and H8 (no producer-declared root trusted) implies P t → Grounded t, i.e. Grounded is the supremum; (T-attain) the system's admission predicate equals Grounded; (T-size-indep) monotonicity/invariance: for corpora C ⊆ C', Grounded t c holds in C ↔ in C' (the predicate never mentions |C|), and Merkle inclusion verification is O(log |C|).
